reviewed_by: Codex review of failed 3.0.3 release browser journeys
reason: The selected release jobs found stale Chat tools, Chat details, and focus-control selectors, plus guides targeting actions hidden inside closed menus. A local production check found the floating Project Snapshot covering the menu, so the selected journey minimizes the panel before opening Chat details. The 320px header also had five controls in a four-column grid. The UI opens the appropriate guide menu and gives each mobile header control its own column. The outdated Zero pixel baseline is replaced with terminal visibility and a retained screenshot artifact. Focused browser entries cover the failed layout, chat tools, header, focus, responsive shell, and all eight real-Core guide profiles; guide component tests cover routing and spotlight behavior.
exclusions: No Python or native source changes, so those test layers are omitted. Other UI journeys, provider workflows, and full suites are excluded. Mobile browsers are emulated; physical-device evidence is unavailable.
